description: This file defines a core infrastructure for a frame processing pipeline in the Pipecat project, including classes for frame processing, queue management, and pipeline control, with emphasis on handling audio/video frames, metrics, and asynchronous task management.

classes.name: FrameProcessorQueue
classes.description: A priority queue that manages system and non-system frames, prioritizing system frames for processing.

classes.name: FrameProcessor
classes.description: Base class for all frame processors in the Pipecat pipeline, managing frame processing, queueing, task control, and event handling.

methods.name: FrameProcessorQueue.put
methods.description: Enqueues a frame, assigning higher priority to SystemFrame instances.

methods.name: FrameProcessorQueue.get
methods.description: Retrieves the next frame, prioritizing system frames.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the frame processor with optional name, direct mode, and metrics.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.setup
methods.description: Sets up the processor with clock, task manager, and observer.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels tasks.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.link
methods.description: Links this processor to a subsequent processor.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.queue_frame
methods.description: Queues a frame for processing, either directly or via internal queue.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.process_frame
methods.description: Processes a given frame based on its type.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.push_error
methods.description: Creates and pushes an error frame upstream.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.push_frame
methods.description: Pushes a frame to the next or previous processor.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__start
methods.description: Handles start frame to initialize processor state.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__cancel
methods.description: Handles cancel frame to stop processing.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__pause
methods.description: Handles pause frame to pause processing.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__resume
methods.description: Handles resume frame to resume processing.

methods.name: FrameProcessor._start_interruption
methods.description: Begins handling an interruption by cancelling current tasks.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__internal_push_frame
methods.description: Internal method to push frames to adjacent processors.

methods.name: FrameProcessor._check_started
methods.description: Checks if the processor has been started.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__create_input_task
methods.description: Creates the input frame processing task.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__cancel_input_task
methods.description: Cancels the input frame processing task.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__create_process_task
methods.description: Creates the main frame processing task.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__reset_process_task
methods.description: Resets the process task and queue.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__reset_process_queue
methods.description: Resets the processing queue, preserving uninterruptible frames.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__cancel_process_task
methods.description: Cancels the processing task.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__process_frame
methods.description: Handles the processing of a frame with event hooks.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__input_frame_task_handler
methods.description: Handles frames from the input queue, processing system frames.

methods.name: FrameProcessor.__process_frame_task_handler
methods.description: Handles non-system frames from the processing queue.
